title: COVID MM-QC Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Set protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the required parameters, specifying the volumes for Component 1 and Component 2 (these volumes can be changed here).

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the generated protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol into the Opentrons OT App.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Set up the deck according to the provided deck map, placing the P300 single‑channel GEN2 electronic pipette, Opentrons aluminum blocks, 2 mL tubes, PCR tube strips, and tip rack in their designated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate the labware, tip rack, and pipette (follow the app’s calibration tips and support articles).

steps.title: Transfer components to tubes and wells
steps.instruction: Perform the three transfer actions as described:

substeps.instruction: Transfer Component 1 and Component 2 into multiple 2 mL tubes (first step).
Transfer reagent from the first tube to nine selected wells in the PCR tube strips (second step).
Transfer Component 3 into the first three wells of the second PCR strip (final step).

steps.title: Start protocol execution
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to execute the protocol.
